mapper.sql: shoe_id AS shoeId, runner_id AS runnerId, shoe_name AS shoeName, brand, max_distance_km AS maxDistanceKm, current_distance_km AS currentDistanceKm, is_default AS isDefault, is_retired AS isRetired, purchased_date AS purchasedDate, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RUNNING_SHOES ( runner_id, shoe_name, brand, max_distance_km, current_distance_km, is_default, is_retired, purchased_date, created_at ) VALUES ( #{runnerId}, #{shoeName}, #{brand}, #{maxDistanceKm}, #{currentDistanceKm}, #{isDefault}, #{isRetired}, #{purchasedDate}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM RUNNING_SHOES WHERE runner_id = #{runnerId}
AND is_retired = FALSE
ORDER BY is_default DESC, is_retired ASC, created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE RUNNING_SHOES SET shoe_name = #{shoeName}, brand = #{brand}, purchased_date = #{purchasedDate}, max_distance_km = #{maxDistanceKm}, current_distance_km = #{currentDistanceKm}, is_default = #{isDefault}, is_retired = #{isRetired}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE shoe_id = #{shoeId} AND runner_id = #{runnerId}
UPDATE RUNNING_SHOES SET is_default = FALSE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE runner_id = #{runnerId} AND is_default = TRUE
UPDATE RUNNING_SHOES SET current_distance_km = GREATEST(0.00, current_distance_km + #{deltaDistanceKm}), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE shoe_id = #{shoeId}
